item.title: DLN Roundup: Balanced scoring powers Macs past Gwynedd
item.description: The Immaculata women’s basketball squad used balanced scoring, defensive pressure, and a dominant fourth quarter to secure an 83–60 road win over Gwynedd Mercy on Saturday afternoon at the Griffin Complex. Meg Robbins led all scorers with a career-high of 17 points and seven rebounds.

item.title: Shanahan tops Great Valley to make Ches-Mont final
item.description: The Bishop Shanahan boys’ basketball team is headed back to Tuesday's Ches-Mont League Championship Game courtesy of an impressive 57-42 semifinal win over Great Valley at West Chester’s Hollinger Field House Saturday afternoon.

item.title: ‘We will pay,’ Savannah Guthrie says in desperate video plea to potential kidnappers of her mother
item.description: Savannah Guthrie told the potential kidnappers of her mother Nancy Guthrie on Saturday that the family is prepared to pay for her safe return.

item.title: Coatesville storms into final after blowing out Whippets
item.description: Saturday night at Hollinger Field House, the Coatesville boys put on a clinic on how to play basketball as the Red Raiders destroyed Downingtown West 98-65 in a Ches-Mont League semifinal.

item.title: West Chester East rallies to reach Ches-Mont League final as freshman Holman stars
item.description: WEST CHESTER — West Chester East freshman Kayla Holman has been improving every game this season. In the Ches-Mont Final Four on Saturday at Hollinger Field House on the campus of West Chester University, Holman announced her arrival to every girls basketball fan in the area. Holman poured in a game-high 25 points as the Vikings broke open a tight game in the second overtime to upend Downingtown East, 60-52, to advance to Tuesday’s championship game.
